full_prompt_en: The image is a square paper collage showing three stylized human figures arranged as a compact group on a pale grey, scuffed background. Two large figures stand behind a smaller child-sized figure at the lower centre. The left figure wears a burnt orange garment and a dark cap or head covering; the right figure wears a vivid magenta jacket with a rounded red-pink hood. Between them, the smaller figure wears a dark blue top and has a narrow, elongated face. All three faces have oversized circular eyes built from concentric black, grey, and ochre rings, with small geometric noses and simplified mouths. The two large faces dominate the upper half, looking forward with fixed expressions; the central child figure sits or stands lower, partially overlapping their torsos. Their proportions are deliberately uneven, with long narrow heads, angular necks, and block-like shoulders. The large heads nearly touch the top edge, and their circular eyes dominate the otherwise spare facial planes. The smaller central face sits beneath them at about chest level, with its gaze aligned forward. Their shoulders and sleeves overlap rather than forming separate full figures, so the group reads as one compressed arrangement of cut shapes. Fine black lines divide garments into panels and trace seams, while small cut-paper rectangles, faint writing-like marks, and worn fragments scatter across the background. The left orange torso fills the lower-left area and ends at a dark horizontal band near the bottom. On the right, the magenta garment spreads broadly toward the edge, with black outlines separating its sleeves and front panels. A narrow blue shape marks the smaller figure at the centre and visually links the larger bodies. The background stays mostly light, but grey smudges and paper fibres create a rough, layered surface. Several fine horizontal and vertical marks cross the pale ground like faint construction lines, while small torn-looking rectangles interrupt the open spaces. Repeated circular eyes draw attention across the group and down towards the smaller central face. Yellow, rust and dark grey fragments divide the mask-like faces, while a thin bent arm-like shape extends from the smaller figure across the magenta area. Flat diffuse light keeps the collage evenly visible, with only shallow shadows along the cut edges. The overall composition clusters the three figures tightly, balancing the two large round-eyed faces above the smaller central one and using orange, magenta, and blue clothing to punctuate the muted paper ground.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形纸拼贴画，浅灰色磨损纸面上并列着三个人形的风格化形象。两位较大的形象站在后方，一位身形较小的孩子位于下方中央。左侧人物穿烧橙色衣物，戴深色帽子或头部覆盖物；右侧人物穿鲜明品红色外套，罩着圆弧形红粉色兜帽。两人之间的小个子形象穿深蓝上衣，脸部狭长。三张脸都有由黑、灰、赭色同心圆构成的夸张大眼，鼻子呈小型几何形，嘴部也经过简化。两张大脸占据上半部，目光固定朝前，神情平板；中央较小的人形位于更低处，局部叠在两侧躯干前方。人物比例刻意不匀称，头部狭长，脖颈棱角分明，肩部像块状结构。两张大头几乎贴近上沿，圆形眼睛占据原本简洁的面部平面。中央小脸位于两者下方、接近胸口高度，视线同样朝前。肩膀与袖管彼此遮叠，没有组成互不相连的完整身形，因此整组人物读作压缩拼接的形状组合。细黑线把衣服分成不同片区并勾出接缝，背景散布小块剪纸、类似字迹的淡痕和磨损碎片。左侧橙色躯干填满左下区域，在底边附近止于一道深色水平带。右侧品红服装向边缘宽阔展开，黑色轮廓线分隔袖管与前襟。中央细窄蓝色形体标记小个子人物，也在两侧较大身形之间形成视觉连接。背景大多保持浅色，但灰色擦痕与纸纤维带来粗粝层次。几道纤细横线与竖线像淡淡结构线般穿过浅色纸面，仿佛撕裂的小矩形则打断部分空处。重复圆眼引导视线扫过整组形象，并向下落到中央小脸。黄色、锈色和深灰碎片分割着面具般的面孔，一条细长弯折的手臂状形体从小个子人物旁横向伸过品红区域。漫射平光让拼贴整体均匀可见，剪纸边缘只有浅浅阴影。整体构图将三个人物紧密聚在一起，让两张大圆眼面孔位于小型中央形象之上，并用橙、品红和蓝色衣物点亮含蓄的纸色背景。
style_prompt_en: The style combines crude collage construction, hand-drawn black contours, and a worn paper ground. Shapes are deliberately angular and disproportionate, with repeated circular motifs providing a strong graphic rhythm. Bright orange, magenta, and blue accents interrupt a pale grey field, while charcoal lines hold the pieces together. Surface marks include faint scuffs, fibres, and small fragmented patches rather than polished gradients. Lighting remains flat and frontal, preserving the cut edges and compact, crowded arrangement. The result feels raw, layered, and visually direct, with colour blocks carrying as much weight as line.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格结合粗粝拼贴结构、手绘黑色轮廓和磨损纸面。形体刻意棱角化、比例失衡，重复的圆形元素带来鲜明图形节奏。明亮橙色、品红与蓝色打破浅灰底面，炭黑线条则将不同碎片连接起来。表面包含淡淡擦痕、纸纤维和零碎拼片，不依赖光滑渐变。光线保持平直正面，使剪纸边缘和紧凑拥挤的布局保留下来。整体呈现粗粝、层叠且直接的视觉感受，色块与线条同样承担重量。
theme_en: Three mask-like figures in a layered paper collage
theme_zh: 旧纸拼贴中的三个人形面具式形象
name: Aboudia
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
